description: Reports the folders of the code that no context file mentions: every top-level folder, or every package of a workspace, that no context file cites a path in and that holds no context file of its own, with the files git tracks in it, its commits in the last ninety days and its last commit, the most active first. It is what the agent is never told about, never a finding: a folder may be left out of the notes on purpose. Nothing is written.

repo.description: Path to the git repository. Defaults to the current working directory of the server.

targets.description: Markdown files or folders to check, relative to the repository. Omit to auto-detect CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, installed SKILL.md files and the rest.

name: prumo_coverage
